svg.title: Northview LED raster with corner returns
svg.desc: Seven LED walls arranged from left to right. Each outlined double panel is 128 by 256 pixels. Cyan single panels are 128 by 128 pixels. Wall 1 has a left 90 degree return: columns 1 and 2 are each six single panels tall, and the corner is between those columns. Wall 4 has a right 90 degree return: columns 4 and 5 are each six single panels tall, and the corner is between those columns. Both walls also have nine double panels. The returns are drawn flat to keep one scale; spacing and alignment are illustrative, and no processor mapping is shown. Total: 212 double panels and 24 single panels, 236 physical panels.

g.aria-label: Left IMAG, 11 columns by 3 rows, 1408 × 768 px, 33 double panels.
Wall 1, five columns, nine double panels and twelve single panels. Left 90 degree return in column 1; corner between columns 1 and 2.
